title: Disneys Wonderful World of Knowledge Volume 1 Animals 1971 Danbury Press HC
conditionDescription: Toning and edge wear, chip to the cloth at the spine top, worn corner. Pages clean.
descriptionText:
Disney's Wonderful World of Knowledge, Volume 1 (Danbury Press, 1971) - the first volume of the Disney children's encyclopedia series, with the bear cubs photo cover and Donald Duck in his red cap on the front and back boards. Hardcover.

Condition: Pre-owned, reading copy. Cover shows toning, edge and corner wear, with rubbing and a chip to the cloth at the spine top and a worn corner (see close-ups). Pages clean. Please review all photos - they are of the actual book you will receive.
